scope: Actual source executed with local mocks; no browser or Firebase test.

findings.classification: Candidate; real Firebase popup lifecycle not verified
findings.trigger: Account A has a pending integration popup; sign in as B and immediately request integration access.
findings.observed: B reuses A pending promise and fails with an account-mismatch error instead of requesting B authorization.
findings.impact: First Calendar/Sheets authorization attempt after account switch fails; retry works. No cross-account token leakage observed.
findings.limitation: Mock permits the first popup to stay pending across sign-in. Firebase may cancel concurrent popups; reachability requires real multi-tab/session testing.

findings.observed: Language initializers in Home and Login throw without a fallback; those components cannot render.
findings.impact: The login screen fails before the Google button is usable in storage-restricted environments.
